30: “What an accursed devil! You frightened me! So you have not gone home?” she said, and laughed aloud.
29: The approaching footsteps of a woman attracted his attention. He began listening, and laughed all by himself. Maryánka with bowed head, striking the pales of the fences with a switch, was walking with rapid regular strides straight towards him. Lukáshka rose. Maryánka started and stopped.
27: “I expect I had better go home too, that will be best,” he said, trying to appear unconcerned but hardly able to repress a smile, and he disappeared behind the corner of the house.
25: Lukáshka rose and raised his cap.
23: “I’m coming,” replied the girl. “Go, my dear, go alone—I’ll come in a minute.”
21: “Nursey Maryánka! Hallo Nursey! Mammy is calling! Supper time!” shouted Maryánka’s little brother, running towards the group.
20: Maryánka shook her head, but did so with a smile.
18: “No really ... what I wanted to say to you, ...” whispered Lukáshka. “By the Heavens! Do come!”
16: “I won’t come, I tell you,” Maryánka suddenly said aloud, leaning away from him.
14: “Really I felt so dull all the time without you, I swear I did,” he said in a calm, restrained whisper, helping himself to some seeds out of the bosom of the girl’s smock, and stooping still closer over her he continued with laughing eyes to talk to her in low tones.
12: Maryánka now smiled outright and unfastened the neckband of her smock.
10: “Till the morning. Give me some sunflower seeds,” he said, holding out his hand.
8: “And have you come for long?” asked Maryánka, smiling slightly.
6: “Oh, how glad I am that I got leave from the cordon!” said Lukáshka, moving closer to the girl and looking straight in her eyes all the time.
2: “Do you think I’ve asked?” answered the girl. “I went to get him some chikhir and saw him sitting at the window with Daddy Eróshka. Red-headed he seemed. They’ve brought a whole cartload of things.”
1: “We’ve let him have the new hut,” she said. “And is he old or young,” asked Lukáshka, sitting down beside her.
0: “And where have you put up the chief?” he asked. Maryánka thought for a moment.
